description: A customizable slider component for React Native that supports iOS, Android, Web, and Windows. Allows users to select a value from a range, supports step markers, custom thumb, track images, and programmatic control.

style.description: Custom styles for the slider container.

disabled.description: If true, disables user interaction with the slider.

lowerLimit.description: Minimum limit user can slide to (Android, iOS, Web).

upperLimit.description: Maximum limit user can slide to (Android, iOS, Web).

step.description: Step increment of the slider. On Windows, default is 1% of slider range.

minimumTrackTintColor.description: Color of the track to the left of the thumb.

maximumTrackTintColor.description: Color of the track to the right of the thumb.

thumbTintColor.description: Color of the slider thumb on Android.

value.description: Initial value of the slider. Not a controlled component.

tapToSeek.description: Allows tapping on track to move thumb.

StepMarker.description: Custom component for each step on the slider.

onSlidingStart.description: Called when user starts dragging the thumb.

onValueChange.description: Called continuously while dragging the thumb.

onSlidingComplete.description: Called when user releases the thumb.

stepMarked.description: True if thumb is currently at this step.

index.description: Index of the step along the slider.

notes: Not a controlled component by default; value can be set initially or programmatically.
Supports custom step markers and step numbers.
Supports images for track and thumb.
Programmatic control via ref is available for Web.
